quest.title: Knights of Favonius
quest.description: You repelled Stormterror with some difficulty. Kaeya of the Knights of Favonius witnessed the battle, and you were invited to make a trip to the Knights headquarters.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x225, Mora x1950, Character EXP x1025, Enhancement Ore x9

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

talks.objective: Enter the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...And once it was over I brought them straight here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I am Jean, Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. This is Lisa, our resident Librarian.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh! Are you sweeties here to help us out?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Stormterror has caused quite a ruckus in the region since its recent resurgence.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Simply put, Mondstadt's elemental sphere and ley lines are now akin to a yarn ball in the paws of a kitten.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: For a mage, it couldn't get much worse. My skin is one elemental particle away from a full-blown breakout.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: If it weren't for this interference, the Knights of Favonius would have better ways to help you than just putting up missing person posters.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #We simply ask that you repose in Mondstadt while we help you seek out your {F#brother}{M#sister}.

choices.text: I really should help out as well.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Good. In that case we need a plan.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: With Stormterror now directly attacking Mondstadt, we may have an opportunity to cut this problem off at the source.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Lisa has revealed the sources of Stormterror's power with her detection magic.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: They're located in the abandoned <color=#00E1FFFF>Four Winds' Temples</color>.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Stormterror's ability to whip up these kinds of storms can be attributed to it drawing power from the temples.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Our objective is to deal with <color=#00E1FFFF>three</color> of the four temples.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I trust everyone understands why we are only dealing with three.

choices.text: It must be a local thing...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Knights of Favonius, time is against us.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The storm is rampant. There is no point in maintaining a defensive position.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Alright. We need to take initiative and act before the situation escalates.

choices.text: Guess we leave it up to you then. Where's the inn?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't be such a slug! We should be a part of this too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the <color=#00E1FFFF>Knights of Favonius Headquarters</color>. Let's take a look inside.
